q: 計劃的核心作用是什麼?
opts: 預測明天價格走勢
在「刺激」和「下單」之間插入一個停頓
讓交易變得更快
保證每一筆都賺錢
why: A plan inserts a pause between the stimulus and the click. That pause is the entire difference between a trader and a gambler — one decision per trade, made once before the open.

q: 以下哪一個不屬於計劃的六大組成?
opts: 市場(做哪個品種、什麼方向)
週期(哪裡決策、哪裡執行)
進場條件(寫到陌生人也能執行)
止盈後立即加倉的規則
why: The six blocks are Market, Timeframe, Entry, Exit, Risk and Daily Target. Adding to a winner is not one of them — risk stays a fixed number that never changes.

q: 如果今天不打算交易,盤前十分鐘檢查清單還要做嗎?
opts: 不做,反正不下單
做,而且每天同一時間、同一順序執行
只做一半,意思一下
改到盤中再補做
why: The routine is the job; the trade is optional. You run the checklist at the same time in the same order every day — even on zero-trade days, and especially during the 30-day build.

q: 按連虧應對手冊,距權益高點 -3R 時應該怎麼做?
opts: 完全停掉實盤
手數減半,繼續做同一套形態
加大手數把虧損賺回來
立刻修改交易計劃
why: Stage 1 at -3R: halve the size but keep trading the same setups — the system is untouched, only exposure drops. Plan changes need 30+ trades of evidence, never 5 losses.

q: 連續虧損兩筆之後,冷卻規則要求你做什麼?
opts: 馬上做下一單把錢賺回來
把止損移寬一點再進場
關掉平台,站起來,離開 30 分鐘
換一個更激進的策略
why: Two consecutive losses → close the platform, stand up, walk away for 30 minutes. Cooldown rules must be physical and immediate — I will just watch is not a cooldown.
